patches.repl:
<script>
    // POLISH: the height of the event card as the CSS variable --gt-evt-h (0 when there is none), so that the story card above it takes exactly the rest of the column.
    // ResizeObserver notifies before the frame is painted: the two cards are never drawn overlapping, not even for one frame.  Without this script the stylesheet reserves 300 px.
    (function () {
      var root = document.documentElement, ro = null, cur = null, last = -1;
      function set(h) { if (h !== last) { last = h; root.style.setProperty('--gt-evt-h', h + 'px'); } }
      function scan() {
        var el = document.querySelector('[data-gtbg-card="1"]');
        if (el !== cur) { if (ro && cur) ro.unobserve(cur); cur = el; if (ro && el) ro.observe(el); }
        set(el ? Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height) : 0);
      }
      function start() {
        var m = document.getElementById('root'); if (!m) return;
        if (window.ResizeObserver) ro = new ResizeObserver(scan);
        if (window.MutationObserver) new MutationObserver(scan).observe(m, { childList: true, subtree: true });
        scan();
      }
      if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start); else start();
    })();
  </script>

  <main id="root">
    <div id="seo-content">
patches.note: publishes the event card height (--gt-evt-h) so that the story card above it takes the rest of the column
